siteTitle: 玉灯奇物馆 · Jade Lantern Curio
siteSubtitle: 东方奇物，静夜心事——以及我们愿意留下的那盏灯。

intro.zh: Maple Hollow 老城的深处，有一家只在夜里亮灯的东方奇物馆。林梅接手了祖母留下的店铺，用真实在售的东方器物——水晶、香、玉器——为每一位深夜推门而入的客人，解开一段心结。这里不写魔法，只写文化、仪式感，与一点恰到好处的温柔。
intro.en: Deep in the old town of Maple Hollow, a curio shop lights up only at night. Lin Mei has inherited her grandmother's store and, with real Eastern curios you can actually buy — crystals, incense, jade — helps each sleepless visitor untangle a knot of the heart. No magic here. Only culture, ritual, and a little well-placed tenderness.
